notes.title: B3 update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Guys, we know you're waiting for news about Blood, Bugs, Bullets or B3 for short! Our team is working on updating the game. And very soon we will show you the new build!

First of all, we will update and improve the co-op mode. You will be able to have fun and hunt bugs together with your friends. A little later we will also update the Caravan mission. 

Be patient and don't switch! The update will be very soon!

Sincerely, B3 Development Team.
